results.body: tlsMutualAuthenticationRequired is enabled while MockServer's CA certificate is the default CA bundled with MockServer, whose private key is published in the MockServer jar, so anyone could create a client certificate MockServer accepts: configure your own CA with certificateAuthorityCertificate and certificateAuthorityPrivateKey, or set dynamicallyCreateCertificateAuthorityCertificate=true, or set tlsMutualAuthenticationCertificateChain to the CA chain that signs your client certificates; for a throwaway local test only, tlsMutualAuthenticationAllowBundledCa=true restores the old behaviour
results.note: upstream #230: data-plane mTLS that would trust the bundled CA (MockServer's CA, no chain) is refused whole

results.body:
<timestamp> - resetting all expectations and request logs
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - tlsMutualAuthenticationAllowBundledCa is fixed at startup and cannot be changed on a running server (it lets mTLS trust client certificates anyone can create, so a request to the control plane cannot enable it) - the supplied value true has been IGNORED and tlsMutualAuthenticationAllowBundledCa remains false; set it before the server starts (system property, environment variable or startup configuration) to change it
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - configuration updated via API
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - control plane PUT /mockserver/configuration changed TLS-sensitive configuration that lowers or alters security posture: 

  tlsMutualAuthenticationCertificateChain repointed ("" -> "{{root}}/tests/files/tls/private-ca/ca-cert.pem")

 — verify this was intended, especially as control plane authentication is disabled by default
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - configuration updated via API
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - no tls for data plane request:

  {
    "method" : "GET",
    "path" : "/anything",
    "headers" : {
      "host" : [ "localhost:<port>" ],
      "content-length" : [ "0" ]
    },
    "keepAlive" : true,
    "secure" : false,
    "protocol" : "HTTP_1_1",
    "localAddress" : "<address>",
    "remoteAddress" : "<address>"
  }

 returning response:

  {
    "statusCode" : 426,
    "reasonPhrase" : "Upgrade Required",
    "headers" : {
      "Upgrade" : [ "TLS/1.2, HTTP/1.1" ],
      "Connection" : [ "Upgrade" ]
    }
  }

------------------------------------
<timestamp> - control plane PUT /mockserver/configuration changed TLS-sensitive configuration that lowers or alters security posture: 

  tlsMutualAuthenticationRequired true -> false (client certificate no longer required); tlsMutualAuthenticationCertificateChain repointed ("{{root}}/tests/files/tls/private-ca/ca-cert.pem" -> "")

 — verify this was intended, especially as control plane authentication is disabled by default
------------------------------------
